responsibility: Validates the `InitMask` byte-initialization tracker’s lazy/materialized representations, growth behavior, overwrite semantics, and chunk iteration/copy invariants through targeted unit tests of initialization-range updates.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `tests.rs`, which exists only for Windows test-linkage, and `util/common/tests.rs`, which checks a formatting helper, this file contains focused behavioral tests for the interpreter allocation `InitMask` data structure, covering initialization tracking, materialization, and growth semantics.
